[[0 ABY]]{{ReturnVadersCastleDate}} |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle''''' is a [[canon]] comic book series written by [[Cavan Scott]]. It was published during [[October]] [[2019]]. The stories featured [[Maul|Darth Maul]], [[Asajj Ventress]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], and [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Grand Moff Tarkin]]. {{Comics-stub}}
